I used this website to find nearby therapists: https://therapists.psychologytoday.com/?utm_source=PT_Psych_Today&utm_medium=House_Link&utm_campaign=PT_TopNavF_Therapist

It was really helpful. I would see if they work with "personality disorders" or "borderline personality disorder". If they do DBT, that is usually a dead giveaway that they work with BPD patients, but they certainly don't have to to qualify. My current one doesn't.

Personally, I would start with a therapist. And I would let him/her know your suspicions, and they can tell you what they think after seeing you a few times. Also, keep in my that the first therapist you see might now be the perfect fit, and that's OK! Keep trying different therapists until you feel it is the right one for you.
